features.note: Thick, dark, clearly arched brows with an angled peak, consistent with the references.
Light grey/greenish almond eyes with the same shape and lid structure.
Long, straight, fairly narrow nose; the tip reads slightly fuller under the harsh light but the structure matches.
Full lips with a cupid's bow, though slightly less plump and less pink than the references.
Oval face with defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; it looks marginally fuller in the cheeks but is not round or broad.
Long black curly hair well past the shoulders, styled in looser, frizzier waves than the tight ringlets in the references.
Curvy hourglass with a full bust, narrow waist and wide hips, shown clearly by the fitted dress; not slimmed.

summary: The candidate closely resembles Priya, with matching brows, eyes, nose and figure, but slightly fuller cheeks and thinner, less defined lips keep it short of an unhesitating match; the frame itself is clean and suitable to animate.
